article.title: 快手第三季擴展UAX多代理協作，素材生成加入興趣訊號
article.summary: 快手在第三季業績公告中披露，UAX全自動投放已由單點策略擴成多代理協作。
highlights: 公司表示，新框架可診斷帳戶投放問題並協調多項投放能力。
AIGC素材工具加入使用者興趣訊號，按既有素材未覆蓋的需求生成補充內容。
article.why: 帳戶診斷和素材補充開始協作，電商投放團隊可檢查應先處理受眾興趣缺口，還是調整出價及活動設定。
article.next_step: 選一個素材覆蓋不足的品類，比較UAX診斷與補充素材建議，分開記錄素材及競價變更。
article.detail: 快手亦披露另一項淨成交ROI產品的更新，包括活動中途切換及訂單取消、退貨模型調整。該產品在電商行銷投放中的滲透率由第二季28.0%升至第三季34.7%。這是公司披露的產品使用比例，團隊可把採用率與自己帳戶的實際銷售、退款及投放變動分開核對。
article.title_en: Kuaishou reports Q3 UAX multi-agent changes and interest-led creative
article.summary_en: Kuaishou's third-quarter release says UAX automated ads evolved from a single-point strategy into a multi-agent framework.
highlights_en: The company says it diagnoses account delivery issues and coordinates multiple ad capabilities.
Its generative creative tool uses interest signals to fill gaps in the existing asset library.
article.why_en: Commerce teams can assess whether an account first needs better interest coverage or changes to bids and campaign settings.
article.next_step_en: Compare UAX diagnostics and suggested creative for one under-covered category and log creative and bidding changes separately.
article.detail_en: A separate Net Transaction ROI product added mid-campaign switching and cancellation and return-model changes. Its share of e-commerce marketing spend rose from 28.0% in Q2 to 34.7% in Q3, according to Kuaishou. That is a usage measure. Teams can assess their own sales, refunds and delivery changes separately.
